3. **Stay Within the Allotted Time**: If you have a specific period of stay, make sure to leave the country before the allotted time ends.

4. **Keep Travel Documents Organized**: Have all your travel documents, including your passport and visa, organized and easily accessible. This can help you quickly show proof of your visa status when needed.
